scope_caveat: Local optimum over the explicitly tested candidate pool only; not a mathematical or global proof of optimality.

authority.note: PASS covers only the 6 complete 100-card configurations in the pool (baseline, preferred five, same-count Heartless Summoning-cut alternative, two six-swap and one seven-swap alternatives) plus named single-card contenders. They were judged with finite current-Oracle rules cases, Commander Spellbook combo lookups and a quantity-counted mana comparison. Tests run locally and in .github/workflows/m7-belakor-the-dark-master.yml; run URLs are recorded in the PR body. There is no statistical multiplayer ranking. The A/B seals and the owner-equivalent Pass C are historical, baseline-scoped and not technically independent. Nothing here implies owner approval, M6 certification, M7 approval or a canonical change.
